els.name: intro_description
els.text: Smartphones continuously collect activity information in the background. These digital signals help researchers understand user habits, attention patterns, movement, and device behavior.

els.name: steps.0.step_item_1.1.step_copy.1.step_description
els.text: Every time a user unlocks the phone, the device records when and how often it is accessed, helping identify usage frequency and attention interruptions.

els.name: steps.1.step_item_2.1.step_copy.1.step_description
els.text: Opening an app generates data about which applications are used most, how often they are opened, and how much time is spent on each one.

els.name: steps.2.step_item_3.1.step_copy.1.step_description
els.text: Incoming alerts from social media, messaging, email, and other apps show how frequently the user is interrupted throughout the day.

els.name: steps.3.step_item_4.1.step_copy.1.step_description
els.text: GPS and location-based services track movement patterns, visited places, travel frequency, and activity timing while location features are enabled.

els.name: steps.4.step_item_5.1.step_copy.1.step_description
els.text: Battery consumption reveals which apps and background processes use the most power, helping identify heavy usage periods and resource-intensive applications.
